title: Missing Pets
summary: Drink to immobilize yourself and gain disadvantage on attacks and checks.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. For 3 turns, you cannot move and have disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls. Guild Artisans in the party can gain An Acquired Taste Inspiration.
fields.Acquisition: Auntie Ethel’s Acrid Workshop at the end of the Overgrown Tunnel.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
